newsitem.title: UK: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON BROADLY UP, EYEING DOW.
newsitem.headline: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON BROADLY UP, EYEING DOW.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London were marginally ahead across the board on Monday, rising with a recovering dollar despite a near four percent fall in the Nikkei 225 average.
"There has been slow and gradual small lots buying across all sectors," said one London-based trader.
"The whole market is 100 percent geared towards what happens in New York," the trader added.
The New York Dow Industrial average slipped shortly after opening higher on Monday as the market remained on edge after Friday's sharp sell-off.
Traders said Sony Corp, up to 11,510 compared with 11,400 at the Tokyo close, was leading the way for the blue chips.
In Tokyo on Monday, the Nikkei average finished at 18,824.18.
